setup.kicker: A new workspace, owned by you
setup.title: Start with your business.
setup.description: Create your business and its first administrator. Your existing installations and accounts are never changed by this setup.
setup.readinessNote: This creates your workspace, not a ready-to-sell certification. Next, configure legal details, taxes, products and your cash register from Settings.
setup.countryHelp: Sets your workspace currency and locale. No tax rates or legal identifiers are invented.
setup.presetHelp: A starting set of tools, not a regulatory approval. You can adjust enabled tools later.
setup.passwordHelp: At least 12 characters, with uppercase, lowercase, a number and a symbol.
setup.tokenHelp: On this computer, copy the private code printed by the Puntovivo server at startup. Do not share it. Restarting the server generates a new code.
setup.tokenInvalid: Enter the 64-character installation code from the server.
setup.closed: This installation already has an owner
setup.signInRecovery: Sign in with the email and password you just chose. You do not need to repeat setup.
setup.closedRecovery: Sign in with the existing owner account. Setup cannot replace an existing owner.
setup.failed: We could not complete setup. Check your connection and try again. If it completed on another screen, sign in with that owner.

server.SETUP_ALREADY_COMPLETED: This installation already has an owner. Sign in with the existing account.
server.SETUP_TOKEN_INVALID: The installation code is invalid or expired. Use the code from the current server session.
server.SETUP_BUSY: Setup is already running or has received too many attempts. Wait a minute before retrying.
server.SETUP_COUNTRY_INVALID: Choose a country from the available list.
server.SETUP_CSRF_REQUIRED: Reload this page before submitting setup again.
server.SETUP_LOCAL_ACCESS_REQUIRED: Create the installation owner on the computer running Puntovivo. Remote setup is not allowed.
